svg.title: The stack, as a punched card
svg.desc: Plate VI. A punched card: one row per work, one column per tool, grouped by the five verbs. A hole means the tool is in that work. Siddhartha: HTML + CSS, JAVASCRIPT, THREE.JS. Orbit: CELERY, DOCKER, EMBEDDINGS, FASTAPI, GH ACTIONS, MINIO, NEXT.JS, PGVECTOR, POSTGRESQL, PYTHON, REDIS, TAILWIND, TYPESCRIPT. Helios: FASTAPI, NEXT.JS, PYTHON, SCIKIT-LEARN, XGBOOST. This Profile: GH ACTIONS, PYTHON, SVG. Gravity Playground: HTML + CSS, JAVASCRIPT. Travelease: HTML + CSS, JAVASCRIPT. Petponks: FIGMA, FRAMER. Spectra: no holes yet. Synchro: no holes yet. Aether: no holes yet.
